fit_predict_prophet_anomaly: fit a ProphetDetectorModel on historical time series data and predict anomaly scores on new data
predict_prophet_anomaly_scores: predict anomaly scores for time series data using a fitted ProphetDetectorModel
detect_trend_changepoints: detect trend changepoints in time series data using ProphetTrendDetectorModel
remove_outliers_prophet: remove outliers from time series data by fitting a Prophet model and filtering points outside the confidence interval
convert_timeseries_to_prophet_df: convert a Kats TimeSeriesData object to a Prophet-compatible pandas DataFrame with ds and y columns
